sloka: उत्तरेभ्य: कुरुभ्यश्च वनं दिव्योपभोगवत् ।आजगाम नदी दिव्या तीजैर्बहुभिर्वृता ॥ २.९१.३१॥
transliteration: uttarebhya: kurubhyaśca vanaṁ divyopabhogavat ।ājagāma nadī divyā tījairbahubhirvṛtā ॥ 2.91.31॥

translations.english: From the forests of the northern Kuru kingdom, with all delights of heaven, a divine river with innumerable trees that grow on river banks came into existence.
